explanations.content: An atom is one basic particle of an element. A molecule is two or more atoms bonded together. A compound is made from atoms of different elements bonded together.
explanations.story: Think of atoms as letters. A molecule is a word made from letters. A compound is a word using different kinds of letters together.

explanations.content: Chemical bonding is not just atoms joining. The key idea is what happens to electrons: ionic bonds transfer electrons, while covalent bonds share electrons.
explanations.story: Two friends can handle lunch money in two ways: one gives money to the other, or both share the cost. Bonds work similarly with electrons.
